paletteByQuality: deep lagoon teal, ivory lace and gold

source: Existing approved Meshy-generated outfit sources owned by the game author; no new Meshy requests.

icons.source3Background: Removed with OpenAI image editing before packing.

footwear: World3 has low and rare footwear IDs. A full epic world3 example uses the actual equipped world2 epic footwear; no synthetic epic world3 item ID.
knownVisualLimits: Rigid hip-weighted long cloth panels can intersect animated legs during deep bends and the late death fall.
Some source trim and tasset boundaries remain visibly segmented at close range.
